title: Endoscopic Ultrasound-Guided Celiac Plexus Neurolysis (EUS-CPN) for Chronic Pancreatitis
official: Endoscopic Ultrasound-Guided Celiac Plexus Neurolysis (EUS-CPN) for Chronic Pancreatitis, Database Repository
summary: Physicians need a tracking system for specific treatment modalities, and data to determine the impact of endoscopic ultrasound pain management for patients with chronic pancreatitis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or older
* Referral for the treatment of pain related to chronic pancreatitis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Less than 18 years of age
* Absence of chronic pancreatitis
